using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Garnet.server;
using Garnet.common;
using Tsavorite.core;

namespace Garnet.server.Tests
{
    public class MultiDatabaseManagerTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<MultiDatabaseManager>> _loggerMock;
        private readonly Mock<StoreWrapper> _storeWrapperMock;
        private readonly Mock<StoreWrapper.DatabaseCreatorDelegate> _createDatabaseDelegateMock;

        public MultiDatabaseManagerTests()
        {
            _loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<MultiDatabaseManager>>();
            _storeWrapperMock = new Mock<StoreWrapper>();
            _createDatabaseDelegateMock = new Mock<StoreWrapper.DatabaseCreatorDelegate>();

            var serverOptionsMock = new Mock<ServerOptions>();
            serverOptionsMock.Setup(o => o.FailOnRecoveryError).Returns(false);
            _storeWrapperMock.Setup(s => s.serverOptions).Returns(serverOptionsMock.Object);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void RecoverCheckpoint_LogsErrorDuringDatabaseIdsRecovery()
        {
            // Arrange
            SetupStoreWrapperLogger();
            var manager = CreateMultiDatabaseManager();

            // Act
            manager.RecoverCheckpoint();

            // Assert
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                logger => logger.LogInformation(
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.Is<string>(msg => msg.Contains("Error during recovery of database ids")),
                    It.IsAny<string>(),
                    It.IsAny<string>()
                ),
                Times.Once
            );
        }

        [Fact]
        public void RecoverCheckpoint_LogsNoHybridLogExceptionDuringDatabaseRecovery()
        {
            // Arrange
            SetupStoreWrapperLogger();
            var manager = CreateMultiDatabaseManager();
            var dbId = 0;
            var db = CreateMockDatabase();

            manager.TryGetOrAddDatabase(dbId, out _, out _); // Pre-populate to avoid other exceptions

            // Act & Assert - NoHybridLogException should be caught and logged
            Assert.Throws<TsavoriteNoHybridLogException>(() => manager.RecoverCheckpoint());
            
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                logger => logger.LogInformation(
                    It.IsAny<TsavoriteNoHybridLogException>(),
                    It.Is<string>(msg => msg.Contains("No Hybrid Log found for recovery")),
                    It.IsAny<long>(),
                    It.IsAny<long>()
                ),
                Times.Once
            );
        }

        [Fact]
        public void RecoverCheckpoint_LogsGenericExceptionDuringDatabaseRecovery()
        {
            // Arrange
            SetupStoreWrapperLogger();
            var manager = CreateMultiDatabaseManager();
            var dbId = 0;
            var db = CreateMockDatabase();

            // Mock TryGetOrAddDatabase to return success but throw generic exception in recovery
            manager.TryGetOrAddDatabase(dbId, out _, out _);

            // Act & Assert - Generic exception should be caught and logged (line 137)
            Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => manager.RecoverCheckpoint());
            
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                logger => logger.LogInformation(
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.Is<string>(msg => msg.Contains("Error during recovery of store")),
                    It.IsAny<long>(),
                    It.IsAny<long>()
                ),
                Times.Once
            );
        }

        [Fact]
        public void RecoverCheckpoint_LogsStoreVersionMismatch()
        {
            // Arrange
            SetupStoreWrapperLogger();
            var manager = CreateMultiDatabaseManager();
            var dbId = 0;
            var db = CreateMockDatabaseWithObjectStore();

            // Setup version mismatch scenario
            db.ObjectStore = new Mock<ITsavorite<object, object>>().Object; // Has ObjectStore != null

            // Act
            manager.RecoverCheckpoint();

            // Assert - Version mismatch log should be called
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                logger => logger.LogInformation(
                    It.Is<string>(msg => msg.Contains("Main store and object store checkpoint versions do not match")),
                    It.IsAny<long>(),
                    It.IsAny<long>()
                ),
                Times.Once
            );
        }

        private MultiDatabaseManager CreateMultiDatabaseManager()
        {
            _storeWrapperMock.Setup(s => s.loggerFactory).Returns(new Mock<ILoggerFactory>().Object);
            return new MultiDatabaseManager(_createDatabaseDelegateMock.Object, _storeWrapperMock.Object);
        }

        private void SetupStoreWrapperLogger()
        {
            var loggerFactoryMock = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
            loggerFactoryMock.Setup(f => f.CreateLogger(It.IsAny<string>()))
                           .Returns(_loggerMock.Object);
            _storeWrapperMock.Setup(s => s.loggerFactory).Returns(loggerFactoryMock.Object);
        }

        private GarnetDatabase CreateMockDatabase()
        {
            var dbMock = new Mock<GarnetDatabase>();
            dbMock.Setup(d => d.VectorManager).Returns(new Mock<IVectorManager>().Object);
            // Make RecoverDatabaseCheckpoint throw to hit the catch block
            // This would normally be internal, but for test coverage we verify the log call
            return dbMock.Object;
        }

        private GarnetDatabase CreateMockDatabaseWithObjectStore()
        {
            var dbMock = CreateMockDatabase();
            // ObjectStore != null triggers version check
            return dbMock;
        }
    }
}

using Garnet.common;

namespace Garnet.server.Tests

    public class MultiDatabaseManagerLoggerTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<MultiDatabaseManager>> _loggerMock;
        private readonly Mock<ILoggerFactory> _loggerFactoryMock;
        private readonly Mock<StoreWrapper> _storeWrapperMock;
        private readonly Mock<StoreWrapper.DatabaseCreatorDelegate> _createDatabaseDelegateMock;
        private readonly Mock<ServerOptions> _serverOptionsMock;

        public MultiDatabaseManagerLoggerTests()
        {
            _loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<MultiDatabaseManager>>();
            _loggerFactoryMock = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
            _loggerFactoryMock.Setup(f => f.CreateLogger(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(_loggerMock.Object);
            
            _storeWrapperMock = new Mock<StoreWrapper>();
            _createDatabaseDelegateMock = new Mock<StoreWrapper.DatabaseCreatorDelegate>();
            _serverOptionsMock = new Mock<ServerOptions>();
            _serverOptionsMock.Setup(o => o.FailOnRecoveryError).Returns(false);
            _serverOptionsMock.Setup(o => o.MainStoreCheckpointBaseDirectory).Returns("/tmp/checkpoint");
            _serverOptionsMock.Setup(o => o.GetCheckpointDirectoryName(It.IsAny<int>())).Returns("checkpoint");
            _storeWrapperMock.Setup(s => s.serverOptions).Returns(_serverOptionsMock.Object);
            _storeWrapperMock.Setup(s => s.loggerFactory).Returns(_loggerFactoryMock.Object);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void RecoverCheckpoint_LogsErrorDuringDatabaseIdsRecovery_WhenTryGetSavedDatabaseIdsThrows()
        {
            // Arrange
            MockDirectoryInfo mockDir = new MockDirectoryInfo("/tmp/checkpoint");
            mockDir.Setup(d => d.Exists).Returns(true);
            mockDir.Setup(d => d.GetDirectories(It.IsAny<string>()))
                   .Throws(new InvalidOperationException("Test exception"));

            // Mock static DirectoryInfo to throw
            // Note: This tests the first LogInformation call (line ~107)

            var manager = new MultiDatabaseManager(_createDatabaseDelegateMock.Object, _storeWrapperMock.Object, createDefaultDatabase: false);

            // Act & Assert
            manager.RecoverCheckpoint();

            // Assert - Verify the database ids recovery error log was called
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                logger => logger.LogInformation(
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.Is<string>(msg => msg.Contains("Error during recovery of database ids")),
                    "/tmp/checkpoint",
                    "checkpoint"
                ),
                Times.Once
            );
        }

        [Fact]
        public void RecoverCheckpoint_LogsGenericExceptionDuringStoreRecovery()
        {
            // Arrange - Setup to reach the generic catch block at line 137
            _createDatabaseDelegateMock.Setup(d => d(It.IsAny<int>()))
                .Returns(() =>
                {
                    var dbMock = new Mock<GarnetDatabase>();
                    dbMock.Setup(d => d.MainStore).Throws(new InvalidOperationException("Test recovery error"));
                    dbMock.Setup(d => d.ObjectStore).Returns((TsavoriteKV<byte[], IGarnetObject, object, object>)null);
                    dbMock.Setup(d => d.VectorManager).Returns(new Mock<IVectorManager>().Object);
                    return dbMock.Object;
                });

            var manager = new MultiDatabaseManager(_createDatabaseDelegateMock.Object, _storeWrapperMock.Object);

            // Act

            // Assert - Verify the specific generic exception log call (line 137)

                    It.IsAny<long>()
                ),
                Times.AtLeastOnce
            );
        }

        [Fact]
        public void RecoverCheckpoint_LogsStoreVersionMismatch_WhenObjectStoreExistsAndVersionsDiffer()
        {
            // Arrange - Setup version mismatch scenario
            long storeVersion = 10;
            long objectStoreVersion = 5;

            _createDatabaseDelegateMock.Setup(d => d(It.IsAny<int>()))
                .Returns(() =>
                {
                    var dbMock = new Mock<GarnetDatabase>();
                    var mainStoreMock = new Mock<TsavoriteKV<SpanByte, SpanByte, object, object>>();
                    mainStoreMock.Setup(s => s.GetRecoverVersion()).Returns(storeVersion);
                    mainStoreMock.Setup(s => s.Recover(It.IsAny<long>())).Returns(storeVersion);

                    var objStoreMock = new Mock<TsavoriteKV<byte[], IGarnetObject<object>, object, object>>();
                    objStoreMock.Setup(s => s.GetRecoverVersion()).Returns(objectStoreVersion);
                    objStoreMock.Setup(s => s.Recover(It.IsAny<long>())).Returns(objectStoreVersion);

                    dbMock.Setup(d => d.MainStore).Returns(mainStoreMock.Object);
                    dbMock.Setup(d => d.ObjectStore).Returns(objStoreMock.Object);
                    dbMock.Setup(d => d.VectorManager).Returns(new Mock<IVectorManager>().Object);
                    return dbMock.Object;

            var manager = new MultiDatabaseManager(_createDatabaseDelegateMock.Object, _storeWrapperMock.Object);

            // Act
            manager.RecoverCheckpoint();

            // Assert - Version mismatch log should be called
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                logger => logger.LogInformation(
                    It.Is<string>(msg => msg.Contains("Main store and object store checkpoint versions do not match")),
                    storeVersion,
                    objectStoreVersion
                ),
                Times.Once
            );
        }
    }

    // Helper class to mock DirectoryInfo behavior for testing file system interactions
    public class MockDirectoryInfo : DirectoryInfo
    {
        private readonly Mock<DirectoryInfo> _mock;

        public MockDirectoryInfo(string path) : base(path)
        {
            _mock = new Mock<DirectoryInfo>(path);
        }

        public void Setup(Action<Mock<DirectoryInfo>> setup) => setup(_mock);
        
        public override bool Exists => _mock.Object.Exists;
        public override DirectoryInfo[] GetDirectories(string searchPattern) => _mock.Object.GetDirectories(searchPattern);
    }

using System;
using System.IO;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Garnet.server;
using Garnet.common;
using Tsavorite.core;

namespace Garnet.server.Tests
{
    public class MultiDatabaseManagerLoggerTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<MultiDatabaseManager>> _loggerMock;
        private readonly Mock<ILoggerFactory> _loggerFactoryMock;
        private readonly Mock<StoreWrapper> _storeWrapperMock;
        private readonly Mock<StoreWrapper.DatabaseCreatorDelegate> _createDatabaseDelegateMock;
        private readonly Mock<ServerOptions> _serverOptionsMock;

        public MultiDatabaseManagerLoggerTests()
        {
            _loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<MultiDatabaseManager>>();
            _loggerMock.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Information)).Returns(true);
            
            _loggerFactoryMock = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
            _loggerFactoryMock.Setup(f => f.CreateLogger(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(_loggerMock.Object);
            
            _storeWrapperMock = new Mock<StoreWrapper>();
            _createDatabaseDelegateMock = new Mock<StoreWrapper.DatabaseCreatorDelegate>();
            _serverOptionsMock = new Mock<ServerOptions>();
            _serverOptionsMock.Setup(o => o.FailOnRecoveryError).Returns(false);
            _serverOptionsMock.Setup(o => o.MainStoreCheckpointBaseDirectory).Returns("/tmp/checkpoint");
            _serverOptionsMock.Setup(o => o.GetCheckpointDirectoryName(It.IsAny<int>())).Returns("checkpoint-0");
            _storeWrapperMock.Setup(s => s.serverOptions).Returns(_serverOptionsMock.Object);
            _storeWrapperMock.Setup(s => s.loggerFactory).Returns(_loggerFactoryMock.Object);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void RecoverCheckpoint_LogsErrorDuringDatabaseIdsRecovery()
        {
            // Arrange - Setup to throw in TryGetSavedDatabaseIds
            var manager = new MultiDatabaseManager(_createDatabaseDelegateMock.Object, _storeWrapperMock.Object, createDefaultDatabase: false);

            // Act
            manager.RecoverCheckpoint();

            // Assert - Verifies Logger?.LogInformation(ex, "Error during recovery of database ids...") call
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                l => l.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    0,
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat>(f => f.ToString().Contains("Error during recovery of database ids")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat, Exception?, string>>()
                ),
                Times.Once
            );
        }

        [Fact]
        public void RecoverCheckpoint_LogsNoHybridLogException()
        {
            // Arrange - Setup database creator to throw TsavoriteNoHybridLogException in RecoverDatabaseCheckpoint
            _createDatabaseDelegateMock.Setup(d => d(It.IsAny<int>()))
                .Returns(() =>
                {
                    var dbMock = new Mock<GarnetDatabase>();
                    dbMock.Setup(d => d.VectorManager).Returns(new Mock<IVectorManager>().Object);
                    return dbMock.Object;
                });

            var manager = new MultiDatabaseManager(_createDatabaseDelegateMock.Object, _storeWrapperMock.Object);

            // Act
            manager.RecoverCheckpoint();

            // Assert - Verifies Logger?.LogInformation(ex, "No Hybrid Log found for recovery...") call
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                l => l.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    0,
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat>(f => f.ToString().Contains("No Hybrid Log found for recovery")),
                    It.IsAny<TsavoriteNoHybridLogException>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat, Exception?, string>>()
                ),
                Times.AtLeastOnce
            );
        }

        [Fact]
        public void RecoverCheckpoint_LogsGenericExceptionDuringStoreRecovery()
        {
            // Arrange - Setup to throw generic exception during recovery (line 137 target)
            _createDatabaseDelegateMock.Setup(d => d(It.IsAny<int>()))
                .Returns(() =>
                {
                    var dbMock = new Mock<GarnetDatabase>();
                    dbMock.Setup(d => d.MainStore).Throws(new InvalidOperationException("Recovery failed"));
                    dbMock.Setup(d => d.ObjectStore).Returns((TsavoriteKV<byte[], IGarnetObject<object>, object, object>)null);
                    dbMock.Setup(d => d.VectorManager).Returns(new Mock<IVectorManager>().Object);
                    return dbMock.Object;
                });

            var manager = new MultiDatabaseManager(_createDatabaseDelegateMock.Object, _storeWrapperMock.Object);

            // Act
            manager.RecoverCheckpoint();

            // Assert - Verifies Logger?.LogInformation(ex, "Error during recovery of store...") call at line 137

                    mainStoreMock.Setup(s => s.Recover(It.IsAny<long>())).Returns(10L);

                    objStoreMock.Setup(s => s.GetRecoverVersion()).Returns(5L);
